about: A Gmail-like inbox as the extension's snapshot gives it: the text of the page's main region with every run of white space made one space (so rows run together), and the controls by role and name (names cut at 80 characters). Each row is a link named by its subject and the start of its preview; nothing in the text says which rows are unread.
